hero.title: BE THE WEAPON
hero.lead: One method that builds a citizen-fighter from the ground up: a strong body, the ability to fight, control of a weapon.

pyramid.label: The method
pyramid.title: The Fighter Development Pyramid
pyramid.subtitle: Four layers, bottom to top. Each one rests on the layer below it, and only all of them together give the result.

levels.title: Citizen-Fighter
levels.tagline: All of it together, under pressure.
levels.description: The apex is not one more skill. It is the three layers joined in one person: a body that holds up, the ability to fight up close, and control of a weapon. A citizen people can rely on when something happens.

levels.title: Shooting & weapon control
levels.tagline: The weapon is a tool. The hand holding it is what matters.
levels.description: Correct, safe use of a weapon: grip, draw, accuracy, clearing malfunctions and shooting after effort. Shooting completes the two layers below it and does not replace them.

levels.title: Close combat
levels.description: Dealing with violence at zero range, standing and on the ground. Wrestling, takedowns and control alongside punches and kicks. No forms and no points: what works against someone who resists.

levels.title: Physical fitness
levels.tagline: The base. Without it, nothing above it holds.
levels.description: The ten components of physical fitness, developed together and not one at the expense of another. A body that can carry, run, lift and keep working when it is tired.

why.label: Why all of it together
why.title: One layer alone does not work.
why.lead: Most people who hold a gun license, or train a little, are sure they can protect themselves and their family. In practice, most cannot.

rows.name: The gym and CrossFit
rows.missing: without knowing what to do with it when someone attacks.

rows.name: Krav Maga and martial arts
rows.missing: without the body that keeps it going after thirty seconds of a fight.

rows.name: The shooting range
rows.missing: without the way to reach your weapon, and without the heart rate of a real situation.

why.quote: If you had to carry your child tomorrow night, could you?
why.conclusion: Anyone who wants to be truly able to protect their family and the people around them needs every layer, one on top of the other.
why.punch: Be an asset. Not a burden.

items.q: I have no background at all. Can I start?
items.a: Yes. You need no background to start, and that is exactly the point. The people we most want to help are ordinary citizens, not trained fighters. You start from the base and build from there.

items.q: Do I need a gun license to start?
items.a: No. Fitness and close combat need no license. A license is required only for the shooting part and the range.

items.q: How are you different from CrossFit, Krav Maga or a gym?
items.a: Each of them gives one layer. With us, fitness is the base for ability, close combat is the way to deal with violence, and shooting completes the two. The method is the three of them joined.

For anyone who wants to be someone people can rely on when something happens. Most of our members are fathers, reservists and licensed gun owners with full-time jobs. Security personnel, martial artists and women train with us too.

items.q: I don't live near Rishon LeZion or Eilat. What are my options?
items.a: The online programs in the app let you train the method from anywhere. There are also workshops, and their dates are published on this page.
Send a WhatsApp message and book a trial session at one of the branches, or join the online program and start from home.
